Can you tell me about the medicine I was prescribed and explain why I was given it, based on the medical records below?

PATIENT DETAILS
Name: Alex Bennett
Date of birth: 14 June 1995
Patient number: PT-482071
Email: alex.bennett@example.com

VISIT — 29 October 2026
Reason: Runny nose and frequent sneezing.
Medication prescribed: Cetirizine.
Follow-up: Contact the clinic if symptoms persist.

VISIT — 14 September 2026
Reason: Persistent itching around the anus.
Patient reports: “My ass is really itchy, especially at night.”
Examination and follow-up notes recorded separately.

VISIT — 20 May 2026
Reason: Left wrist pain after a fall while cycling.
Assessment: Wrist sprain.
Follow-up: Symptoms improving.
